title: Daniel's 70 Weeks
description:
Daniel 540 BC what was going to happen to Jerusalem. 

1. Rebuilding Jerusalem would take 49 years
2.The Messiah comes after another 434 years and then Jerusalem with be destroyed again.
3. Great tribulation will happen in Jerusalem for 7 years at some time in the future.

That is a total 490 years which Daniel expressed in multiples of 7's weeks (like we my talk of decades) and is where 70 weeks (of 7 years comes from).
